author: Temmycreative
title: Looking for a paid vector illustrator (Halloween merch)
content: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid). Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s–90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt. Requirements: one skeleton as the main character; punk/rock retro horror vibe; clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS); large back print (13" × 16"); neon green, purple & orange palette; original artwork only (no tracing existing designs). Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price. Follow-up from author: Must be an Adobe Illustrator. Please DM if available. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @temmycreative_.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Seeking fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with. For character art: realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; lighter fantasy book; open to styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Needs portraits for now, with potential for more if the style fits the series. For the map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Author is still replying to applicants. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.
